responsibility: Implements stdarg optimization and va_arg lowering on GIMPLE. It analyzes stdarg functions to determine whether va_list objects escape and how much of the target’s register save area must actually be preserved for later va_arg uses, and it also expands IFN_VA_ARG internal calls by invoking the target va_arg gimplification hook, splitting CFG as needed and updating SSA, so both stdarg save-area optimization and generic va_arg representation are handled in the tree middle end.
same_name_distinction: Implements the stdarg pass behavior: analyzes va_list usage to optimize saved register areas and lowers IFN_VA_ARG by invoking target va_arg gimplification hooks and updating CFG/SSA. Unlike gcc/tree-stdarg.h, which only defines the stdarg_info state structure, this file contains the algorithms and pass execution.
